In [[382 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Jedi Knight]] [[Porter Engle]] was involved in<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars: The High Republic: Chronicles of the Jedi]]''</ref> the five-[[Standard day|days']] long<ref name="Characters of" /> '''siege of Bardotta''', fighting hundreds of [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] and [[pirate]]s on the [[planet]] [[Bardotta]]. The feat earned him the title "Blade of Bardotta<ref name="Chronicles" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[in-universe]] [[book]] ''[[Chronicles of the Jedi]]'', [[Author|written]] by [[Jedi]] Master [[Harli Cogra]], incorrectly states that [[Barash Silvain]] took her [[Barash Vow|vow]] after her plan to help the people of Bardotta failed and many [[Death|died]] as a result during the siege.<ref name="Chronicles" /> A [[Siege of Firevale|similar set of events]], though not on Bardotta, but on [[Gansevor]], was later established in ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic — The Blade]]'' to be the reasoning for why Silvain undertook the vow. The series also established that Engle only traveled to Bardotta after his sister had taken the vow.<ref name="The Blade 4" />
